I changed `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 6517). Its purchase-order subquery now also requires `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, so cancelled purchase orders no longer count towards a rep.

Reps with no purchase orders in the period still appear with 0, and the ordering is the same as before. In your example, Anna gets 2 and Bob gets 1.

No existing test calls this method, so I added no test and haven't run your example against the database. The `*DataStore*` test run passed without errors, but it doesn't cover this change.
